aspect: Asymmetric cost is the whole strategy
description: A party who can absorb legal fees indefinitely can impose them on a party who cannot. Merits become close to irrelevant.
energy_note: Winning is not required. Outspending is.

description: The resolution routinely requires a non-disclosure term, so the pattern is not visible to the next person it happens to.
energy_note: Paid to stop, and to stop saying.

description: 'We note your client's position and look forward to testing it. We anticipate a four-day hearing and will be instructing leading counsel.' There is no allegation in the letter and no offer. It exists to communicate the size of the bill.
energy_note: A letter whose only content is the cost of replying.

aspect: Legal aid does not cover most of it
description: Where representation is unfunded, the choice is self-representation against counsel, or capitulation. Both are described afterwards as the party's own decision.
energy_note: Choosing to lose, and it going down as your choice.
